title: Learning and Steering in Incomplete-Information Games
title_zh: 不完全信息博弈中的学习与引导

paragraphs.en: In many modern multi-agent systems, a mediator seeks to influence strategic decision dynamics using only outcome-level feedback and without knowing agents’ utilities. In this work, we study how a mediator can learn an unknown game and steer adaptive agents toward outcomes that maximize her utility using only trajectory feedback. The mediator knows the game form and her own objective, but not the agents’ utilities. Moreover, she commits to nonnegative payments and provides recommendations and contexts, but receives only a single realized terminal outcome rather than full-information feedback. We develop halving-type algorithms that learn utility differences in normal-form games and conditional continuation-value differences in extensive-form games, achieving a sample complexity of O ~ ​ ( ε − 2 ) \widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}) that matches worst-case lower bounds up to logarithmic factors. We then combine these learning procedures with a Lagrangian formulation in an online Learn–Compute–Steer algorithm that interleaves learning, equilibrium computation, and steering toward mediator-optimal extensive-form correlated equilibria (EFCE). With high probability, the Learn–Compute–Steer algorithm achieves a directness gap and an optimality gap of O ~ ( T − 1 / 4 ) \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/4}) , while time-average payments are of O ~ ( T − 1 / 8 ) \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/8}) .
paragraphs.zh: 在许多现代多智能体系统中，中介者试图仅利用结果层面的反馈、在不了解智能体效用的情况下影响策略性决策动态。 在本工作中，我们研究中介者如何仅利用轨迹反馈来学习未知的博弈，并将自适应的智能体引导至能最大化其自身效用的结果。 中介者知道博弈形式和自己的目标函数，但不知道智能体的效用。 此外，她承诺提供非负支付，并给出推荐和上下文，但只收到单一的现实终局结果，而非完全信息反馈。 我们开发了半分型算法，在标准式博弈中学习效用差异，在扩展式博弈中学习条件续值差异，达到了 \widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}) 的样本复杂度，该复杂度在对数因子范围内匹配最坏情形下的下界。 然后我们将这些学习过程与拉格朗日表述相结合，提出一种在线的「学习–计算–引导」算法，该算法交替进行学习、均衡计算以及向中介者最优的扩展式相关均衡（EFCE）引导。 以高概率，「学习–计算–引导」算法实现 \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/4}) 的直接性差距和最优性差距，而时间平均支付为 \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/8})。

paragraphs.en: Classical game theory is primarily concerned with a forward problem: given agents’ preferences and the rules of interaction, how will strategic agents behave? This perspective underlies equilibrium analysis and its many refinements, which characterize stable patterns of play assuming agents optimize against one another. In many modern applications, however, a designer, platform, or principal does not know agents’ utilities a priori. Although much of the literature on the inverse problem of learning the game itself from observations assumes that observed behavior corresponds to an equilibrium outcome ( Kuleshov and Schrijvers, 2015 ) , this assumption is often untenable in practice. First, equilibrium play may be computationally expensive to obtain in large games, as computing Nash equilibria is PPAD-hard in general ( Daskalakis et al., 2006 ) . Second, even when equilibria are well-defined, real-world agents typically adapt online under limited information and changing conditions, so their behavior need not settle at, or even approximate, any fixed equilibrium profile within the time horizon of interest. This raises a complementary inverse and control-oriented question: given only observed behavior from adaptive agents, how can a principal both learn about the strategic environment and shape long-run outcomes toward objectives of its own?
paragraphs.zh: 经典博弈论主要关注一个正向问题：给定智能体的偏好和交互规则，策略性的智能体将如何行动？ 这一视角是均衡分析及其众多精细化研究的基础，它们在假设智能体彼此进行最优化的前提下刻画稳定的博弈模式。 然而，在许多现代应用中，设计者、平台或委托人并不事先知道智能体的效用。 尽管关于从观测中学习博弈本身这一逆向问题的大多数文献都假设观测到的行为对应于某个均衡结果（Kuleshov and Schrijvers, 2015），但在实践中这一假设往往站不住脚。 首先，在大型博弈中获得均衡策略的计算成本可能很高，因为计算纳什均衡在一般情况下是 PPAD 难的（Daskalakis et al., 2006）。 其次，即使均衡是良定义的，现实中的智能体通常在信息有限和条件变化的情形下在线适应，因此其行为未必会在相关时间范围内收敛到、甚至逼近任何固定的均衡策略组合。 这就引出了一个互补的、面向控制的逆向问题：仅凭从自适应智能体那里观测到的行为，委托人如何既能了解策略环境，又能将长期结果塑造得符合其自身目标？

paragraphs.en: A natural behavioral model in such settings is one where agents employ no-regret learning algorithms rather than explicitly computing equilibria, as no-regret dynamics provide a principled foundation for predicting long-run behavior in multi-agent interactions ( Nekipelov et al., 2015 ) . Moreover, when each player runs a no-regret algorithm, the induced time-averaged play approaches equilibria notions such as correlated equilibrium (CE) and coarse correlated equilibrium (CCE) in general-sum normal-form games (NFGs) ( Hart and Mas-Colell, 2000 ; Cesa-Bianchi and Lugosi, 2006 ) . Furthermore, regret-minimization methods and their equilibria convergence guarantees extend to extensive-form games (EFGs) ( Zinkevich et al., 2007 ; Lanctot et al., 2009 ; Tammelin, 2014 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在此类环境中，一个自然的行为模型是：智能体采用无遗憾学习算法，而不是显式地计算均衡，因为无遗憾动态为预测多智能体交互中的长期行为提供了有原则的基础（Nekipelov 等，2015）。 此外，当每个参与者运行无遗憾算法时，所诱导的时间平均玩法在一般和正常形式博弈（NFG）中会逼近相关均衡（CE）与粗相关均衡（CCE）等均衡概念（Hart 和 Mas-Colell，2000；Cesa-Bianchi 和 Lugosi，2006）。 进一步地，遗憾最小化方法及其均衡收敛保证可以扩展到扩展形式博弈（EFG）（Zinkevich 等，2007；Lanctot 等，2009；Tammelin，2014）。

paragraphs.en: In many socio-technical settings, however, there is also a principal or mediator with an objective function distinct from those of the agents. Such a mediator can intervene by providing information, recommendations, or incentives that influence agents’ learning trajectories. In extensive-form games, a natural solution concept for this mediated interaction is extensive-form correlated equilibrium (EFCE), which unifies information design and incentive constraints into a single implementability object ( von Stengel and Forges, 2008 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在许多社会技术场景中，还存在一个委托人或中介者，其目标函数不同于各智能体的目标函数。 这样的中介者可以通过提供信息、建议或激励来进行干预，从而影响智能体的学习轨迹。 在扩展式博弈中，这种由中介介入的交互的一个自然解概念是扩展式相关均衡（EFCE），它将信息设计与激励约束统一为单一的可实施性对象（von Stengel and Forges, 2008）。

sents.zh: 然而，在许多社会技术场景中，还存在一个委托人或中介者，其目标函数不同于各智能体的目标函数。

paragraphs.en: A central obstacle in multi-stage settings is the mediator’s limited observability. We distinguish between two feedback regimes. In the first setting, full-information feedback , the mediator observes sufficient information to evaluate or estimate utilities for deviations beyond the realized play, e.g., full-information payoff vectors in normal-form games or counterfactual value information in EFGs. In the second setting, trajectory feedback , in each iteration the mediator observes a single realized terminal outcome together with the information sets visited by each player along their trajectories, and can base payments only on the realized outcome. In this work, we focus on designing mediator algorithms that work in the trajectory-feedback regime. Formally, we ask the question:
paragraphs.zh: 在多阶段场景中，一个核心障碍是智能体的可观测性受限。 我们区分两种反馈机制。 在第一种设定，即全信息反馈中，智能体能够获得足够的信息来评估或估计超出实际对局之外的偏离的效用，例如标准式博弈中的全信息收益向量，或扩展式博弈中的反事实价值信息。 在第二种设定，即轨迹反馈中，智能体在每次迭代中观察到单个实际实现的终端结果，以及每个玩家沿其轨迹所经过的信息集，并且只能基于实际实现的结果进行支付。 在本工作中，我们专注于设计能在轨迹反馈机制下运作的智能体算法。 形式化地，我们提出如下问题：

paragraphs.en: Without knowing the players’ utilities and observing only realized trajectories, can a mediator steer no-regret learners to optimal EFCE, while her payments vanish on average?
paragraphs.zh: 在不知道参与者的效用、且仅能观察到已实现的轨迹的情况下，中介者能否引导无后悔学习的智能体达到最优的EFCE（扩展型相关均衡），同时她所支付的款项在平均意义上趋近于零？

paragraphs.en: We answer this question in the affirmative by making the following contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过做出以下贡献来肯定地回答这个问题。

paragraphs.en: In Section 3 , we develop algorithms that learn utility differences in normal-form games (Algorithm 2 ) and conditional continuation-value differences in extensive-form games (Algorithm 4 ), both with sample complexity O ~ ​ ( ε − 2 ) \widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}) . This dependence matches the normal-form lower bounds of Zhang et al. (2025a) and extensive-form lower bounds in Proposition 3.16 up to logarithmic factors. Moreover, we show that learning conditional continuation-value differences suffices to evaluate the EFCE incentive constraints, which, as we later establish, enables the mediator to steer players toward a desired EFCE.
paragraphs.zh: 在第3节中，我们开发了在规范式博弈中学习效用差异的算法（算法2）以及在扩展式博弈中学习条件延续价值差异的算法（算法4），两者的样本复杂度均为 O ~ ​ ( ε − 2 ) \widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}) 。 这种依赖关系与 Zhang 等人的规范式下界相匹配。 即 (2025a) 以及命题 3.16 中的扩展式下界，仅相差对数因子。 此外，我们证明学习条件延续价值差异足以评估 EFCE 激励约束，而正如我们稍后所证实的，这使得调解者能够引导智能体走向期望的 EFCE。

sents.en: Moreover, we show that learning conditional continuation-value differences suffices to evaluate the EFCE incentive constraints, which, as we later establish, enables the mediator to steer players toward a desired EFCE.

paragraphs.en: In Section 4 , we present online Learn–Compute–Steer algorithm (Algorithm 6 ) that combines learning, equilibrium computation, and trajectory-feedback steering. We show that, the directness gap and the optimality gap relative to the mediator’s optimal EFCE value diminish with the rate of O ~ ( T − 1 / 4 ) \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/4}) , while time-average payments vanish with the rate of O ~ ( T − 1 / 8 ) \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/8}) , with high probability. Finally, in Section 5 , we complement the analysis with experiments in a normal-form Stag Hunt game and extensive-form Kuhn Poker instances.
paragraphs.zh: 在第4节中，我们提出在线「学习–计算–引导」算法（算法6），该算法将学习、均衡计算与轨迹反馈引导相结合。 我们证明，相对于调解者最优EFCE值的直接性差距和最优性差距以 O ~ ( T − 1 / 4 ) \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/4}) 的速率递减，而时间平均支付以 O ~ ( T − 1 / 8 ) \widetilde{O}(T^{-1/8}) 的速率趋近于零，且以上结论均以高概率成立。 最后，在第5节中，我们通过在标准式猎鹿博弈和扩展式库恩扑克实例上的实验来补充该分析。

sents.en: Finally, in Section 5 , we complement the analysis with experiments in a normal-form Stag Hunt game and extensive-form Kuhn Poker instances.
sents.zh: 最后，在第5节中，我们通过在标准式猎鹿博弈和扩展式库恩扑克实例上的实验来补充该分析。

paragraphs.en: A broad literature studies inverse problems in games—inferring agents’ preferences from observed behavior—under names such as learning from revealed preferences and inverse game theory. Classical revealed-preference models focus on identifying utility parameters from choices under rationality assumptions ( Beigman and Vohra, 2006 ; Zadimoghaddam and Roth, 2012 ) , while inverse game-theoretic work develops identification and estimation methods for multi-agent utilities, often positing that the observed play corresponds to an equilibrium or a noised observation of it ( Kuleshov and Schrijvers, 2015 ; Wu et al., 2022 ; Goktas et al., 2024 ) . Our setting departs from these equilibrium-based formulations as we assume that the principal observes the agents’ strategies over repeated play, potentially far from equilibrium, and seeks to learn and intervene the process.
paragraphs.zh: 大量文献研究博弈中的逆问题——即从观测到的行为推断智能体的偏好——这类研究常被称为显示偏好学习和逆博弈论。 经典的显示偏好模型侧重于在理性假设下从选择中识别效用参数（Beigman 和 Vohra, 2006；Zadimoghaddam 和 Roth, 2012），而逆博弈论方面的工作则针对多智能体效用发展识别与估计方法，通常假设观测到的行为对应于某个均衡或其带噪声的观测（Kuleshov 和 Schrijvers, 2015；Wu 等, 2022；Goktas 等, 2024）。 我们的设定不同于这些基于均衡的表述：我们假设委托人在重复博弈中观测智能体的策略，这些策略可能远离均衡，而委托人试图学习并干预这一过程。

paragraphs.en: Our perspective is closely aligned with recent work that studies how a mediator can simultaneously learn an unknown game and influence agents’ behavior under learning-based behavioral assumptions. Most closely related to our learning procedure (Section 3 ), ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) show that a principal can learn an unknown game with sample complexity O ~ ​ ( ε − 2 ) \tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}) and establish a matching information-theoretic lower bound of Ω ~ ​ ( ε − 2 ) \tilde{\Omega}(\varepsilon^{-2}) . A key limitation, however, is that their guarantees are developed for normal-form settings and do not extend to EFGs; moreover, their upper bounds do not match the lower bound with respect to dependence on the players’ action-space sizes, which can be prohibitively large in practice. We address these issues in the present work, and provide a comparison of our results in Table 1 . Importantly, similar to ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , ( Yorulmaz et al., 2025 ) , in this work we assume that the players are no-regret within each mediator-provided context . Related themes also appear in the literature on principal–agent interaction with learning agents and on contract design under uncertainty, where the principal must reason about an agent that adapts over time ( Lin and Chen, 2025 ; Guruganesh et al., 2024 ; Dütting et al., 2021 ; Freeman et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的观点与近期研究密切相关，这些研究探讨了中介方如何在基于学习的行为假设下同时学习未知博弈并影响智能体的行为。 与我们的学习过程（第 3 节）最相关的是，(Zhang et al., 2025a) 证明了一个委托方能够以样本复杂度 O ~ ​ ( ε − 2 ) \tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2}) 学习未知博弈，并建立了信息论意义下 Ω ~ ​ ( ε − 2 ) \tilde{\Omega}(\varepsilon^{-2}) 的匹配下界。 然而，其关键局限在于，他们的保证仅针对正规型设定建立，无法扩展到扩展式博弈（EFGs）；此外，其上界在关于参与者动作空间规模的依赖关系上与下界不匹配，而该规模在实践中可能大到难以承受。 我们在本文中解决了这些问题，并在表 1 中对我们的结果进行了比较。 重要的是，与 (Zhang et al., 2025a)、(Yorulmaz et al., 2025) 类似，我们在本工作中假设参与者在每个由中介方提供的上下文内满足无悔性。 相关主题还出现在关于委托方与学习型智能体交互以及不确定性下契约设计的文献中，其中委托方必须对随时间适应的智能体进行推理 (Lin and Chen, 2025; Guruganesh et al., 2024; Dütting et al., 2021; Freeman et al., 2020)。

paragraphs.en: Building on this viewpoint, we pursue a different downstream objective. Rather than merely estimating utilities, we integrate learning the underlying game , which constitutes the Learn component of our framework, with equilibrium-oriented steering , which constitutes the Compute–Steer component, in multi-stage games under trajectory feedback. A complementary line of work studies how to steer adaptive agents by shaping rewards under partial knowledge of agents’ dynamics, often using control-theoretic viewpoints ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Canyakmaz et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2022 ) . These approaches typically model specific learning dynamics, whereas, for the steering problem, we assume only regret guarantees within each mediator-provided context, as in the Learn component of our framework, and focus on steering agents toward a mediator-optimal EFCE.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一观点，我们追求一个不同的下游目标。 我们不仅仅是估计效用，而是在轨迹反馈下的多阶段博弈中，将学习底层博弈（即我们框架的 Learn 组件）与面向均衡的引导（即我们框架的 Compute–Steer 组件）相结合。 一条互补的研究路线探讨如何在仅部分了解智能体动态的情况下，通过塑造奖励来引导自适应智能体，通常采用控制论的视角（Huang et al., 2025；Canyakmaz et al., 2025；Gong et al., 2022）。 这些方法通常对特定的学习动态进行建模，而对于引导问题，我们只假设在每个由中介提供的环境中具有后悔保证（如同我们框架的 Learn 组件），并专注于将智能体引导至中介最优的 EFCE。

paragraphs.en: Most directly related to our Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm, Algorithm 6 , ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) introduce a trajectory-feedback steering framework that drives no-regret agents toward a desired equilibrium while maintaining vanishing average payments. They also ask whether there exists a fully online trajectory-feedback algorithm that attains the mediator-optimal equilibrium, and we answer this question in the affirmative in the present work assuming that players have no regret within each mediator-provided context for EFCE. Our result in this work, compared to earlier ones can be found in Table 2 , where offline steering refers to steering toward a known equilibrium, whereas online steering refers to simultaneously computing an equilibrium and steering the players toward it. All results hold for EFGs. Earlier work on implementation via payments is also conceptually aligned with our use of nonnegative, outcome-dependent transfers to enforce obedience ( Monderer and Tennenholtz, 2003 ) .

(2024) 提出了一个轨迹反馈引导框架，使无悔智能体趋向期望均衡，同时保持平均支付趋于零。 他们还提出问题：是否存在一种完全在线的轨迹反馈算法能够达成中介最优均衡，我们在本工作中给出了肯定回答，假设参与者在中介提供的每个EFCE上下文内都是无悔的。 本工作的结果与早期工作的比较见表2，其中离线引导指引导向一个已知的均衡，而在线引导指同时计算一个均衡并引导参与者趋向它。 所有结果都适用于扩展式博弈。 关于通过支付实现机制早期的工作也与我们对使用非负的、依赖结果的转移支付来确保服从在概念上是一致的（Monderer and Tennenholtz, 2003）。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, our mediated interaction model is closely related to the Bayesian persuasion framework and information design problems, where a sender commits to an information structure to shape receivers’ behavior ( Kamenica and Gentzkow, 2011 ; Bergemann and Morris, 2019 ) . Moreover, BCE provides a unifying implementability object that captures both Bayes plausibility and incentive constraints, while it subsumes classical correlation/communication concepts in games with information ( Bergemann and Morris, 2016 ; Forges, 1986 ; Myerson, 1986 ) . In extensive-form settings, related implementability notions include extensive-form correlated equilibrium (EFCE) and its computational treatments ( von Stengel and Forges, 2008 ) . Related to our mediated steering model, ( Yorulmaz et al., 2025 ) provide results characterizing what can be achieved under information-design constraints when the objective is to steer agents’ behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，我们的中介交互模型与贝叶斯说服框架和信息设计问题密切相关，在这些框架中，发送方承诺一种信息结构来塑造接收方的行为（Kamenica and Gentzkow, 2011; Bergemann and Morris, 2019）。 此外，BCE 提供了一个统一的可实施性对象，它同时刻画了贝叶斯合理性约束和激励约束，并且涵盖了带信息的博弈中的经典相关/通信概念（Bergemann and Morris, 2016; Forges, 1986; Myerson, 1986）。 在扩展式博弈的情形中，相关的可实施性概念包括扩展式相关均衡（EFCE）及其计算方面的研究（von Stengel and Forges, 2008）。 与我们的中介引导模型相关，Yorulmaz 等（2025）给出了刻画在信息设计约束下、当目标为引导智能体行为时所能达成结果的研究。

paragraphs.en: Finally, our setting is related to work on strategizing against or exploiting agents, as well as to Stackelberg and commitment perspectives. Literature shows that a principal can extract value against no-regret learners, motivating equilibrium-free analyses in repeated interaction ( Deng et al., 2019 ; Mansour et al., 2022 ; Braverman et al., 2018 ; Kolumbus and Nisan, 2022 ) . In Stackelberg settings, there are works on learning optimal commitments and dynamic Stackelberg equilibria under various models of follower response ( Conitzer and Sandholm, 2006 ; Letchford et al., 2009 ; Haghtalab et al., 2022 ; Lauffer et al., 2024 ) . In a related direction, ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) provide impossibility results and identifies what information must be known in order to steer a learning follower through the leader’s actions. Comparably, we focus on a mediator who chooses contexts, recommendations, and payments to induce mediator-optimal outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们的设定与针对智能体进行策略化或利用智能体的相关工作有关，也与 Stackelberg 视角和承诺视角相关。 文献表明，委托人可以从无遗憾学习者身上提取价值，这推动了在重复交互中不依赖均衡的分析（Deng 等，2019；Mansour 等，2022；Braverman 等，2018；Kolumbus 和 Nisan，2022）。 在 Stackelberg 设定方面，已有工作在各种追随者响应模型下研究学习最优承诺与动态 Stackelberg 均衡（Conitzer 和 Sandholm，2006；Letchford 等，2009；Haghtalab 等，2022；Lauffer 等，2024）。 在一个相关的方向上，（Zhang 等，2025b）给出了不可能性结果，并指出了为了通过领导者的行动引导学习型追随者必须知道哪些信息。 与之类似，我们关注的是一个选择情境、建议和支付以诱导中介最优结果的中介。

sents.zh: 在 Stackelberg 设定方面，已有工作在各种追随者响应模型下研究学习最优承诺与动态 Stackelberg 均衡（Conitzer 和 Sandholm，2006；Letchford 等，2009；Haghtalab 等，2022；Lauffer 等，2024）。

sents.en: In a related direction, ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) provide impossibility results and identifies what information must be known in order to steer a learning follower through the leader’s actions.
sents.zh: 在一个相关的方向上，（Zhang 等，2025b）给出了不可能性结果，并指出了为了通过领导者的行动引导学习型追随者必须知道哪些信息。

sents.en: Comparably, we focus on a mediator who chooses contexts, recommendations, and payments to induce mediator-optimal outcomes.
sents.zh: 与之类似，我们关注的是一个选择情境、建议和支付以诱导中介最优结果的中介。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, for each player i i , we let 𝒞 i \mathcal{C}_{i} be a context space. Before play in round t t , the mediator chooses κ ( t ) ∈ ∏ i 𝒞 i \kappa^{(t)}\in\prod_{i}\mathcal{C}_{i} , and player i i observes κ i ( t ) \kappa_{i}^{(t)} . Contexts identify the learning environments used by the players. Crucially, we assume that each player maintains a separate learning state for each context and updates it only on rounds carrying that context . Returning to a context resumes its existing state; using a new context initializes a previously unused state. Context selection may depend on the preceding interaction, but is made before the current round’s play randomization and Nature’s moves. All contexts concern the same underlying game; the mediator’s payments and recommendation protocol determine the round-wise augmented interaction.

paragraphs.en: The learning and steering analyses below use deterministic regret inequalities. For randomized learners, these inequalities may instead be understood on a high-probability event. paragraphs.en: In the ex-ante EFCE recommendation device, the mediator samples a joint pure profile s ¯ ∼ μ \bar{s}\sim\mu , where μ ∈ Δ ⁡ ( 𝒮 ) \mu\in\Delta(\mathcal{S}) , independently of Nature’s moves. paragraphs.en: As stated, we aim to learn the players’ utility differences by choosing contexts and payments. Stated naively, this goal is impossible to achieve due to an inherent identifiability issue. In specific no-regret algorithms such as FTRL ( Abernethy et al., 2008 ) and OMD ( Nemirovski and Yudin, 1983 ) , an agent’s incentives depend only on utility differences between actions. Consequently, for any collection of functions W i : A − i → ℝ W_{i}:A_{-i}\to\mathbb{R} that do not depend on a i a_{i} , the shifted utilities u i ′ ​ ( a i , a − i ) := u i ​ ( a i , a − i ) + W i ​ ( a − i ) u_{i}^{\prime}(a_{i},a_{-i}):=u_{i}(a_{i},a_{-i})+W_{i}(a_{-i}) induce the same comparisons for agent i i at every ( a i , a − i ) (a_{i},a_{-i}) . Hence, based on partial feedback alone, one cannot distinguish Γ \Gamma from the game Γ ′ \Gamma^{\prime} obtained by applying such shifts. Therefore, utilities are only learnable up to additive terms W i ​ ( a − i ) W_{i}(a_{-i}) . Formally, given a game Γ \Gamma and precision ε > 0 \varepsilon>0 , we say that the principal ε \varepsilon -learns Γ \Gamma if it outputs estimates u ^ i : A → ℝ \hat{u}_{i}:A\to\mathbb{R} for each agent i i such that there exist functions W i : A − i → ℝ W_{i}:A_{-i}\to\mathbb{R} satisfying | u i ​ ( a i , a − i ) − u ^ i ​ ( a i , a − i ) − W i ​ ( a − i ) | ≤ ε , ∀ i ∈ [ n ] , ∀ ( a i , a − i ) ∈ A . \bigl|u_{i}(a_{i},a_{-i})-\hat{u}_{i}(a_{i},a_{-i})-W_{i}(a_{-i})\bigr|\;\leq\;\varepsilon,\forall i\in[n],\ \forall(a_{i},a_{-i})\in A.
paragraphs.zh: 如前所述，我们的目标是通过选择情境和支付来学习参与者的效用差异。 朴素地陈述的话，由于存在固有的可辨识性问题，这一目标是无法实现的。 在诸如 FTRL（Abernethy 等人，2008）和 OMD（Nemirovski 与 Yudin，1983）等特定的无悔算法中，智能体的激励只取决于动作之间的效用差异。 因此，对于任何不依赖于 $a_i$ 的函数集合 $W_{i}:A_{-i}\to\mathbb{R}$，移位后的效用 $u_{i}^{\prime}(a_{i},a_{-i}):=u_{i}(a_{i},a_{-i})+W_{i}(a_{-i})$ 在每个 $(a_{i},a_{-i})$ 处为智能体 $i$ 诱导出相同的比较结果。 于是，仅凭部分反馈，无法把 $\Gamma$ 与通过施加这种移位得到的博弈 $\Gamma^{\prime}$ 区分开。 因此，效用在加性项 $W_{i}(a_{-i})$ 的范围内才是可学习的。 形式化地说，给定一个博弈 $\Gamma$ 和精度 $\varepsilon>0$，如果委托人输出的估计 $\hat{u}_{i}:A\to\mathbb{R}$（对每个智能体 $i$）满足：存在函数 $W_{i}:A_{-i}\to\mathbb{R}$ 使得 $\bigl|u_{i}(a_{i},a_{-i})-\hat{u}_{i}(a_{i},a_{-i})-W_{i}(a_{-i})\bigr|\;\leq\;\varepsilon,\forall i\in[n],\ \forall(a_{i},a_{-i})\in A$，我们就说委托人 $\varepsilon$-学习了 $\Gamma$。

paragraphs.en: We now extend our learning procedure to finite perfect-recall extensive-form games under trajectory feedback. Unlike in normal-form games, an observed terminal history in an extensive-form game reveals only the actions taken along the realized path, leaving behavior at unreached information sets unobserved. Since regret is evaluated against opponents’ actual realization plans, their behavior in unobserved branches of the game may differ from the principal’s prescribed strategies, even when they comply along the realized path. Thus, a unilateral deviation leading to unreached branches, may cause counterfactual payoffs that cannot be inferred from the observed trajectories. This creates an additional difficulty when learning conditional continuation values . Furthermore, the information set whose continuation values we seek to learn may be reached only on a subset of rounds. To address these difficulties, we extend the two-level payment procedure developed for normal-form games by incentivizing prescribed behavior outside the queried information set and introducing terminal-dependent payments that protect the queried player’s strategies against opponents’ deviations, without requiring observation of the players’ strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在将学习程序扩展到具有轨迹反馈的有限完美 recall 扩展式博弈。 与标准式博弈不同，扩展式博弈中观测到的终止历史只揭示实现路径上采取的动作，而未到达信息集处的行为则无法观测。 由于遗憾值是针对对手的实际实现方案来评估的，因此即使在实现路径上他们遵守约定，对手在博弈未被观测分支中的行为也可能与主要参与方规定的策略不同。 因此，导致未到达分支的单方面偏离，可能产生无法从观测轨迹中推断出的反事实收益。 这在学习条件延续值时带来了额外的困难。 此外，我们希望学习其延续值的信息集可能只在部分轮次中才会到达。 为了解决这些困难，我们扩展了为标准式博弈开发的两层支付程序：通过激励被查询信息集之外的规定行为，并引入依赖于终止结果的支付来保护被查询参与方的策略免受对手偏离的影响，且无需观测参与方的策略。

sents.en: We now extend our learning procedure to finite perfect-recall extensive-form games under trajectory feedback.
sents.zh: 我们现在将学习程序扩展到具有轨迹反馈的有限完美 recall 扩展式博弈。

sents.en: Unlike in normal-form games, an observed terminal history in an extensive-form game reveals only the actions taken along the realized path, leaving behavior at unreached information sets unobserved.
sents.zh: 与标准式博弈不同，扩展式博弈中观测到的终止历史只揭示实现路径上采取的动作，而未到达信息集处的行为则无法观测。

sents.en: Since regret is evaluated against opponents’ actual realization plans, their behavior in unobserved branches of the game may differ from the principal’s prescribed strategies, even when they comply along the realized path.
sents.zh: 由于遗憾值是针对对手的实际实现方案来评估的，因此即使在实现路径上他们遵守约定，对手在博弈未被观测分支中的行为也可能与主要参与方规定的策略不同。

sents.en: Thus, a unilateral deviation leading to unreached branches, may cause counterfactual payoffs that cannot be inferred from the observed trajectories.
sents.zh: 因此，导致未到达分支的单方面偏离，可能产生无法从观测轨迹中推断出的反事实收益。

sents.en: This creates an additional difficulty when learning conditional continuation values .
sents.zh: 这在学习条件延续值时带来了额外的困难。

sents.en: Furthermore, the information set whose continuation values we seek to learn may be reached only on a subset of rounds.
sents.zh: 此外，我们希望学习其延续值的信息集可能只在部分轮次中才会到达。

sents.en: To address these difficulties, we extend the two-level payment procedure developed for normal-form games by incentivizing prescribed behavior outside the queried information set and introducing terminal-dependent payments that protect the queried player’s strategies against opponents’ deviations, without requiring observation of the players’ strategies.
sents.zh: 为了解决这些困难，我们扩展了为标准式博弈开发的两层支付程序：通过激励被查询信息集之外的规定行为，并引入依赖于终止结果的支付来保护被查询参与方的策略免受对手偏离的影响，且无需观测参与方的策略。

paragraphs.en: For EFGs, our learning objective is determined by the incentive constraints of the extensive-form correlated equilibrium (EFCE) that we seek to steer players towards. To understand our learning object, we consider the standard ex-ante recommendation device defined in Section 2.5 . Under this protocol, evaluating a unilateral deviation amounts to comparing the expected terminal utilities of two complete contingent strategies of the deviating player, with the other players’ prescribed contingent strategies fixed. We therefore learn the expected utility differences that determine these comparisons, rather than attempting to recover the terminal utilities u i ​ ( z ) u_{i}(z) .

paragraphs.en: We now use the preceding results to construct our learning algorithm for extensive-form games given in Algorithm 3 . As in the normal-form sections, we apply the two-payment search separately to each target action. For a fixed query ( s ¯ , i , I , a ) (\bar{s},i,I,a) , the mediator tests the two payment levels Δ k − \Delta_{k}^{-} and Δ k + \Delta_{k}^{+} in separate epochs, assigns their labels using the observed counts ( V , X ) (V,X) , and updates the bracket according to ( 26 ). By Proposition 3.13 , each successful iteration preserves the unknown threshold and reduces the bracket width. Algorithm 3 terminates when the bracket width is at most 2 ​ ε 2\varepsilon and returns its midpoint as the estimate of θ i , I s ¯ ​ ( a ) \theta_{i,I}^{\bar{s}}(a) . The following theorem establishes the accuracy and sample complexity of Algorithm 3 , when all such tests satisfy the high-probability statements.

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, if the players’ utilities were known, one could first compute an optimal EFCE by linear programming and then steer toward that fixed recommendation law. Here, the incentive constraints are initially unknown, and the explicit optimization problem can be large, making it generally more expensive to solve than performing a single step of a regret minimizer ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . In particular, a distribution over 𝒮 \mathcal{S} has one coordinate for each complete pure strategy profile, and | 𝒮 | |\mathcal{S}| can be exponential in the size of Γ \Gamma . Therefore, our approach instead updates the recommendation law through regret minimization steps through a Lagrangian formulation, using increasingly accurate continuation estimates while steering proceeds.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，如果参与者的效用是已知的，就可以先通过线性规划计算出一个最优的扩展型相关均衡（EFCE），然后引导系统趋向该固定的推荐法则。 在这里，激励约束起初是未知的，且显式的优化问题可能规模很大，因此求解它通常比执行一次遗憾最小化器的单步更新（Zhang et al., 2024）代价更高。 特别地，𝒮 \mathcal{S} 上的一个分布在每个完整的纯策略组合上都有一个坐标，而 | 𝒮 | |\mathcal{S}| 可能相对于 Γ \Gamma 的规模呈指数级增长。 因此，我们的方法转而通过拉格朗日形式的遗憾最小化步骤来更新推荐法则，在引导过程进行的同时使用精度不断提高的延拓估计。

paragraphs.en: We now present our Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm, Algorithm 6 , which combines learning continuation values, computing an optimal EFCE for the mediator, and steering players towards it. The rounds are split between learning and steering. For q ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) q\in(0,1) , round t t is a learning round when ⌊ t q ⌋ > ⌊ ( t − 1 ) q ⌋ . \lfloor t^{q}\rfloor>\lfloor(t-1)^{q}\rfloor. Thus, when 𝒥 > 0 \mathcal{J}>0 , the first t t rounds contain exactly ⌊ t q ⌋ \lfloor t^{q}\rfloor learning trajectories. On a learning round, the players receive the payments in ( 20 )–( 21 ); on a steering round, they receive the payments in ( 41 ). The mediator’s two regret-minimization algorithms are updated on every round, using the matrix A ^ ( t ) \widehat{A}^{(t)} obtained from the most recently completed continuation table.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在给出我们的学习-计算-引导（Learn-Compute-Steer）算法，即算法 6，它将学习延续价值、为中介者计算最优 EFCE 以及将玩家引导至该 EFCE 结合起来。 各轮次在学习与引导之间分配。 对于 q ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) q\in(0,1)，当 ⌊ t q ⌋ > ⌊ ( t − 1 ) q ⌋ \lfloor t^{q}\rfloor>\lfloor(t-1)^{q}\rfloor 时，第 t t 轮为学习轮。 因此，当 𝒥 > 0 \mathcal{J}>0 时，前 t t 轮恰好包含 ⌊ t q ⌋ \lfloor t^{q}\rfloor 条学习轨迹。 在学习轮中，玩家获得 ( 20 )–( 21 ) 中的支付；在引导轮中，他们获得 ( 41 ) 中的支付。 中介者的两个遗憾最小化算法在每一轮都会更新，使用从最近完成的延续表中得到的矩阵 A ^ ( t ) \widehat{A}^{(t)}。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the online learn–compute–steer procedure, Algorithm 6 on a normal-form Stag Hunt game and an extensive-form, two-player Kuhn poker game ( Kuhn, 1950 ) . In the experiments, the mediator updates its recommendation distribution by MWU ( Yoav Freund, 1995 ) and its internal deviation policies by CFR+ ( Tammelin, 2014 ) . During steering, players also use CFR+ in the recommendation-augmented game.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates the different time scales of obedience and recommendation improvement. Players follow the mediator’s recommendations after the first updates. Once both players obey, the deviation-compensation payment is no longer incurred, and each player receives only the compliance bonus α t \alpha_{t} . The payment curves thus reflect both the dilution of early compensation payments and the subsequent decay of α t \alpha_{t} . Optimality improves more gradually because the mediator must continue improving her recommendation distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了服从度与推荐质量提升的不同时间尺度。 在首次更新之后，玩家会遵循中介的建议。 一旦双方玩家都服从，偏差补偿支付不再发生，每个玩家仅收到顺从奖励 α t \alpha_{t} 。 因此，支付曲线既反映了早期补偿支付的稀释，也反映了 α t \alpha_{t} 的后续衰减。 最优性的提升则较为渐进，因为中介必须持续改进其推荐分布。

The initial movement toward ( 0.5 , 0.5 ) (0.5,0.5) reflects players learning to follow the initially near-uniform recommendations. Once obedience is established, the trajectories track the recommendation marginals. Their subsequent diagonal movement toward ( 1 , 1 ) (1,1) reflects the symmetry of the game and the mediator’s computation progressively concentrating recommendations on the optimal outcome ( S , S ) (S,S) . Thus, the trajectories distinguish the rapid establishment of obedience from the slower improvement of the recommendations being followed.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we have developed online learning and steering algorithms for general-sum EFGs under trajectory feedback. For game learning, our algorithm achieves a sample complexity of 𝒪 ⁡ ( ϵ − 2 ) \mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2}) , matching the information-theoretic lower bound of ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . For steering, we have provided an online algorithm that steers players with no regret within each mediator-provided context toward the mediator’s optimal equilibrium set at a rate of 𝒪 ( T − 1 / 4 ) \mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4}) . We further have illustrated the performance of our algorithms through numerical experiments on representative EFGs and normal-form games.
paragraphs.zh: 本文针对一般和扩展式博弈（EFG）在轨迹反馈下，开发了在线学习与引导算法。 在博弈学习方面，我们的算法达到了 𝒪 ⁡ ( ϵ − 2 ) \mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2}) 的样本复杂度，与（Zhang et al., 2025a）的信息论下界相匹配。 在引导方面，我们提供了一个在线算法，能在每个中介提供的环境中将无悔的参与者以 𝒪(T−1/4) 的速率引导至中介的最优均衡集合。 我们进一步通过在代表性扩展式博弈和标准型博弈上的数值实验，展示了我们算法的性能。

sents.zh: 在引导方面，我们提供了一个在线算法，能在每个中介提供的环境中将无悔的参与者以 𝒪(T−1/4) 的速率引导至中介的最优均衡集合。

paragraphs.en: Several directions remain open, including improving convergence rates of the defined gap functions, developing trajectory-implementable incentive mechanisms with lesser payments, and extending the framework to Markov games and partially observable Markov games (POMGs). Another important direction would be relaxation of the assumption of no regret within each mediator-provided context in favor of more standard learning guarantees. Finally, alternative optimization reductions and trajectory-feedback implementations of existing full-information incentive schemes may offer pathways to stronger theoretical and practical guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 仍有若干方向有待探索，包括改进所定义的间隙函数的收敛速度、设计支付更少的可由轨迹实现的激励机制，以及将该框架扩展到马尔可夫博弈和部分可观测马尔可夫博弈（POMGs）。 另一个重要方向是放松在每个中介机构所提供情境内无悔这一假设，转而采用更标准的学习保证。 最后，替代性的优化归约以及现有全信息激励方案的轨迹反馈实现方式，可能为获得更强的理论与实践保证提供途径。

paragraphs.en: Throughout this appendix, we fix a player i i , a fixed opponents’ action profile y ∈ A − i y\in A_{-i} , and a target action a ∈ A i a\in A_{i} . We first establish the opponent-pinning and leakage bounds used throughout the analysis. paragraphs.en: Lemma D.2 shows that opponent deviations along the observed trajectories occur on relatively few rounds. However, this alone is not sufficient to control the queried player’s regret: an alternative strategy may lead to information sets that were never visited during actual play, where the opponents’ behavior need not agree with s ¯ − i \bar{s}_{-i} . The following lemma addresses this difficulty by providing an upper bound on the number of mistakes made by player i i at the queried information set and deviations made by player i i outside that information set, in terms of the deviations of other players and regret and concentration terms.
paragraphs.zh: 引理 D.2 表明，对手沿观测轨迹的偏离发生在相对较少的轮次上。 然而，仅凭这一点不足以控制被查询玩家的后悔值：替代策略可能导致到达在实际对局中从未访问过的信息集，而在这些信息集上，对手的行为未必与 s ¯ − i \bar{s}_{-i} 一致。 下面的引理通过以下方式解决这一困难：就其他玩家的偏离以及后悔项和集中项而言，为玩家 i i 在被查询信息集处所犯的错误次数以及玩家 i i 在该信息集之外的偏离提供一个上界。

paragraphs.en: We first show that T = Ω δ ​ ( 𝒥 ​ log ⁡ ( 1 / ε ) log ⁡ 𝒥 ) T=\Omega_{\delta}\big(\frac{\mathcal{J}\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\log\mathcal{J}}\big) by embedding a family of normal-form games into extensive-form games. Consider an n n -player game in which each player has two actions, A i = { 0 , 1 } A_{i}=\{0,1\} . Represent the game in extensive form by letting players act sequentially, without observing any preceding actions. Thus each player has a single information set I i I_{i} , reached with probability one.

At each chance node c j c_{j} , one outcome leads to player 2’s information set I j I_{j} , while the other one continues to the next chance node. If Nature takes the continuation branch at every chance node, play reaches the final information set I h I_{h} of player 1. At each information set, the acting player chooses between actions 0 0 and 1 1 , after which the game terminates.
